texts.zh: 我们已经定位了一名位于[target.Capital.GetName]上的帝国显贵，其名为[operation_target.GetName]，其职权虽然不大但是对于维系帝国对星系的控制力至关重要。如果我们能抹除这名目标，那么我们就能充分地昭告，对[target.GetRulerTitle]阿谀奉承之辈永远别想安全无虞。
texts.en: We have identified an Imperial dignitary on [target.Capital.GetName] by the name of [operation_target.GetName] that serves a small but critical role in maintaining the Imperium's yoke on the galaxy. Eliminating this target would amply demonstrate that no lackey of the [target.GetRulerTitle] is safe.

texts.zh: 我们已经定位了一个位于[target.Capital.GetName]之上的自律[target.GetIndividualName]，其功能是维系[target.GetRulerTitle]和其帝国属民之间的联系。若能对这个[target.GetIndividualName]进行抹杀，那将是我们对抗星海帝国取得的微小却又至关重要的胜利。
texts.en: We have identified an autonomous [target.GetIndividualName] on [target.Capital.GetName] that functions as a liaison between the [target.GetRulerTitle] and its Imperial subjects. The elimination of this [target.GetIndividualName] would be a small but important victory in the fight against the Galactic Imperium's tyranny.

texts.zh: 这是一个位于[target.Capital.GetName]之上的自律无人机，其功能是维系[target.GetRulerTitle]和其帝国属民之间的连结能力。使这个无人机永久地离线能够打击帝国的内部联络——至少是在替代无人机被编程之前。
texts.en: There is an autonomous drone on [target.Capital.GetName] that operates in a liaison capacity between the [target.GetRulerTitle] and its Imperial subjects. Permanently offlining this drone would hamper the Imperium's internal communication - at least until a replacement is programmed.

texts.zh: [operation_target.GetName]，一名帝国安全总局的[agent_origin.GetSpeciesName]特工，对于[operation_target.GetHerHis]的工作有着不同寻常的热枕。[operation_target.GetSheHeCap]亲自负责逮捕了数百名“异见分子”——其中的几名为我们工作。时机已经到了，这名帝安局特工的光辉前程应该戛然而止，并一劳永逸地彻底终止。
texts.en: [operation_target.GetName], a [agent_origin.GetSpeciesName] agent of the Imperial Security Directorate, is particularly apt at [operation_target.GetHerHis] job. [operation_target.GetSheHeCap] [operation_target.GetIsAre] personally responsible for the arrest of hundreds of "dissidents" - several of whom were working for us. It is time for this ISD agent's illustrious career to come to a premature and very permanent end.

texts.zh:
帝国海军是[target.GetRulerTitle]的利剑，长悬于帝国成员国的头顶之上，随时准备着以迅雷不及掩耳之势将任何叛乱的苗头抹杀。

我们已经定位了一名特别的舰队情报军官，一名[agent_origin.GetSpeciesName]人，名字为[operation_target.GetName]，此人负责多项反骚乱行动。这名军官的暴毙将对对方造成重创。
texts.en:
The Imperial Armada is the sword of the [target.GetRulerTitle], constantly hovering over the heads of Imperium's members and ready to come thundering down at the slightest sign of rebellion.

We have identified a particular Armada intelligence officer, a [agent_origin.GetSpeciesName] by the name of [operation_target.GetName], who oversees many of their anti-insurgency operations. The demise of this officer is long overdue.

texts.zh: 在[target.Capital.GetName]有一座[target.GetRulerTitle]的特别纪念碑，其安全出现了可乘之机。如果我们可以摧毁这座纪念碑，那我们就能向全星系昭示，反叛运动甚至有能力直击帝国的心脏地段。
texts.en: Security is lax around a particular monument of the [target.GetRulerTitle] on [target.Capital.GetName]. Destroying this monument will prove to the galaxy that the rebel movement can strike even at the very heart of the Imperium.

texts.zh: 我们的特工想方设法获得了进入下水道网络的权限，能够通往帝国安全总局在当地的办事处。只要炸药管够，我们就能够把这栋帝安局的建筑还有里面的工作人员一口气送上天。
texts.en: Our operatives have managed to secure access to a network of underground sewage tunnels running underneath a local branch office of the Imperial Security Directorate. With enough explosives, it should be possible to bring down the entire ISD building along with any agents inside it.

texts.zh:
帝国海军在整个星海帝国各处的行星上设立了征募中心。在各个征兵处，征兵官正忙着将来自各个成员国的愣头青登记成大兵。这些傻大个马上就会被灌满谎言，还要发誓效忠[target.GetRulerTitle]。

摧毁一个这样的征募中心将向各界发送一个强烈的讯息，那就是背叛自己的种族，同帝国沆瀣一气，其代价将会十分沉重。
texts.en:
The Imperial Armada has established recruitment centers on planets across the Galactic Imperium. At these sites, their recruiters fill the Armada's ranks with the gullible youth of the Imperium's numerous member states. These naive fools are then fed lies and conditioned to obey the [target.GetRulerTitle].

Destroying one of these centers would send a powerful message that betraying your own kind and siding with the Imperium carries a steep price.

texts.zh: 我们已经定位了一个位于[target.Capital.GetName]之上的亚空间传输器，帝国使用这个东西向整个星海帝国展开宣传攻势。如果我们的特工能够从源头改变传输信号，哪怕仅仅只是一会，我们就能够通过官方的帝国亚空间输送载体传送我们自己的宣传材料。
texts.en: We have located a Subspace Transmitter on [target.Capital.GetName] that is used to transmit Imperial propaganda across the Galactic Imperium. If our operatives can divert these transmissions at the source, even for a brief moment, we could transmit our own material on the official Imperial subspace carrier wave.

texts.zh: 在等待数日之后，狙击小队的一名特工逮到了一个完美时机，在极远的距离一击穿透[operation_target.GetName]办公室的窗户将[operation_target.GetHerHis]射杀。在任何人注意到目标死亡之前，小队就拆卸了步枪，并有条不紊地转移到了撤离点。
texts.en: After waiting several days for the right moment, one of our sniper teams eliminated [operation_target.GetName] at extreme range by firing through the window of [operation_target.GetHerHis] office. The team then dismantled their rifle and were well on their way to the extraction point before anyone had even noticed the target was down.

texts.zh: 在旁观者看来，[operation_target.GetName]最近在一场悲惨的车祸中丢掉了[operation_target.GetHerHis]的性命，载具在[operation_target.GetSheHe]开动的那一刻爆炸了。帝国官方怀疑是有人在暗中搞事，但是那些精心摆放的炸药压根就没剩下来，没法通过这件事追查到我们的特工身上。
texts.en: To those bystanders who witnessed the event, [operation_target.GetName] recently lost [operation_target.GetHerHis] life in a tragic hover car accident when the vehicle [operation_target.GetSheHe] [operation_target.GetWasWere] traveling in seemed to spontaneously explode. Imperial authorities likely suspect foul-play, but there is not enough of the carefully placed explosive remaining to link our operatives to the deed.

texts.zh: 通过研究目标私人住所的监控系统，我们发现前门的控制面板存在一个安全纰漏。我们的特工把这个面板捣鼓了一下，确保下一次被人使用时会触发一个强烈的放电。[operation_target.GetName]回家之后操作了这个面板，结果，[operation_target.GetSheHe]就被突然释放的电流裂解成了地上的一滩灰，只留下[operation_target.GetHerHis]的护卫在原地目瞪口呆。
texts.en: Surveillance of the target's personal residence revealed a security flaw in the control panel used to open the front door. Our operatives rigged the panel to trigger a powerful energy discharge when used. When [operation_target.GetName] returned home shortly afterwards and used the panel, [operation_target.GetSheHe] disintegrated into a pile of ash right in front of [operation_target.GetHerHis] astonished escort detail.

texts.zh: 一个战术刺杀小队试图伏击目标和其护卫，在经过一段简单的、一边倒的交火之后，所有目标[from.target.GetIndividualNamePlural]都被击杀。我方的所有特工都安然无恙地脱离，现在处于潜伏状态，等到局势放松之后再进行安全地撤离。
texts.en: A tactical kill team managed to ambush the target and its escort, successfully eliminating all of the [from.target.GetIndividualNamePlural] after a brief and one-sided firefight. All of our operatives escaped unharmed and are now laying low until conditions allow for their safe extraction.

texts.zh: 目标随身的猎寻者无人机让正面进攻变得不可能，因此我们需要寻找替代方案。我方特工重编了一个自动化轨道货船，让其看上去是在驶离繁忙的[target_country.Capital.GetName]轨道空间前往帝国别处执行任务，实际上却是同目标无人机的私人穿梭机相撞。引发的爆炸轰天震地，目标无人机的记忆核心一个渣滓都没留下给人打捞。
texts.en: The target's hunter-killer drone escort made a frontal attack impossible, so an alternate approach was required. Our operatives reprogrammed an automated orbital freighter to collide with the target drone's personal shuttle as it was leaving the busy orbital space of [target_country.Capital.GetName] for a mission elsewhere in the Imperium. The resulting explosion was powerful enough that no trace of the drone's memory core remained to be salvaged.

texts.zh: 我们的特工以外科手术式的精准排放好小型炸药网，引爆后严重破坏了位于[target_country.Capital.GetName]上[target_country.GetRulerTitle]纪念碑的支撑结构。宏伟的雕像缓缓倒下，砸在地上化为了数不尽的碎片。当地政府赶到现场的时候，我们的特工已经在前往撤离点的路上了。
texts.en: With surgical precision, the network of small explosives planted by our operatives severed the supports of the monument to the [target_country.GetRulerTitle] on [target_country.Capital.GetName]. The massive statue then slowly toppled from its platform and shattered into a million pieces as it hit the ground. By the time the local authorities arrived on the scene, our operatives were already on their way to their exfiltration points.

texts.zh: 当深埋地下的炸药引爆的时候，整栋帝安局建筑都化成了灰，徒留地上一个新近形成的大坑，以及到处倒坍的砾石。等到帝安局增援部队赶到并在这片区域建立一个警戒区的时候，我们的特工早已逃之夭夭，去往了其他的星球。
texts.en: When the underground explosives were detonated, the entire ISD office building disappeared into the newly formed crater and collapsed on itself. By the time ISD reinforcements arrived to establish a cordon around the area, our operatives had been safely relocated offworld.

texts.zh: 由我们的特工精心掩埋在募兵中心四周的炸药网被引爆，所有的炸药在同一时刻触发了引信。伤亡惨重。尽管帝国海军总能在帝国疆域的其他地方拉到新兵蛋子，但至少这次行动被视作一次标志性的打击，足够让[target_country.GetRulerTitle]心有余悸一段时间了。
texts.en: A network of carefully concealed explosives planted by our operatives around the Recruitment Center detonated as one when their trigger was fired. Casualties were heavy, and although the Imperial Armada is certain to find the recruits it needs elsewhere in the Imperium, this is at least a symbolic blow that will be felt by the [target_country.GetRulerTitle] for some time.

texts.zh: 在接入亚空间传输器之后，我们的特工上传了一段[target_country.GetRulerTitle]在帝国参议院前作公开演讲的鬼畜版本。在这个版本中，演讲包含了粗俗和下流的词句，让各位参议员大感迷惑，演讲最终以帝皇陛下[target_country.ruler.GetHerHis]本人的自爆结束。
texts.en: After interfacing with the Subspace Transmitter, our operatives uploaded a doctored version of the latest public address made by the [target_country.GetRulerTitle] before the Imperial Senate. In this version, the speech contains vulgar and obscene language directed at the bewildered Senators, eventually concluding with [target_country.ruler.GetHerHis] Imperial Majesty's spontaneous combustion.

texts.zh: 在接入亚空间传输器之后，我们的特工上传了一段[target_country.GetRulerTitle]在帝国参议院前作公开演讲的恶搞版本。在这个版本中，演讲包含了粗俗和下流的词句，让各位参议员大感迷惑，演讲最终以[target.GetGovernmentName]揭发了一个缇扬奇企图颠覆帝国的阴谋结束。
texts.en: After interfacing with the Subspace Transmitter, our operatives uploaded a doctored version of the latest public address made by the [target_country.GetRulerTitle] before the Imperial Senate. In this version, the speech contains vulgar and obscene language directed at the bewildered Senators and it concludes with the [target.GetGovernmentName] announcing its discovery of a massive Tiyanki plot to overthrow the Imperium.

texts.zh: 在接入亚空间传输器之后，我们的特工上传了一段[target_country.GetRulerTitle]在帝国参议院前作公开演讲的鬼畜版本。在这个版本中，演讲包含了粗俗和下流的词句，让各位参议员大感迷惑，演讲最终以机械智能宣布自己将立即把意识传输到参议院大楼的某个饮料分发器上结束。
texts.en: After interfacing with the Subspace Transmitter, our operatives uploaded a doctored version of the latest public address made by the [target_country.GetRulerTitle] before the Imperial Senate. In this version, the speech contains vulgar and obscene language directed at the bewildered Senators and it concludes with the Machine Intelligence announcing the imminent transfer of its entire consciousness into a random beverage dispenser somewhere in the Senate complex.

title.zh: 恐怖分子削弱帝国权威！

texts.zh: 身份不明的特工近期刺杀了一名位于[Root.Capital.GetName]上的帝国要员！行凶者躲避了追捕，但我们深信这场刺杀是一系列企图动摇星海帝国并削弱我们权威的精心策划行动的一部分。某一位星海帝国的成员国可能就是幕后主谋！
texts.en: Unidentified agents recently assassinated an Imperial dignitary on [Root.Capital.GetName]! The perpetrators eluded capture, but we believe the assassination is part of a concerted effort to destabilize the Galactic Imperium and undermine our authority. One of the Imperium's member states is likely behind this!

texts.zh: 一名身居高位的帝国安全总局官员最近被不明势力的特工刺杀了！帝安局的分析师认为这一行动是星海帝国的某位成员国尝试削弱[Root.GetRulerTitle]的权威，很可能一场公开的叛乱已经在私下里开始谋划了！
texts.en: A high-ranking officer of the Imperial Security Directorate was recently assassinated by agents working for an unknown power! Analysts at the ISD think it likely that this is an attempt by one of the Imperium's member states to undermine the authority of the [Root.GetRulerTitle], and perhaps set the stage for an open revolt against our rule!

texts.zh: 一名身居高位的帝国海军情报官员最近被不明势力的特工刺杀了！这一可耻的恐怖主义行径很有可能出自某位不忠的星海帝国成员国，而它很有可能还在盘算着什么大计划削弱我们的权威。
texts.en: A high-ranking intelligence officer in the Imperial Armada was recently assassinated by agents acting on behalf of an unknown power! This shameful act of terrorism is likely part of a larger effort to undermine our authority by a disloyal member state of the Imperium.

texts.zh: 不满分子最近消灭了一个我们的自律眼线！尽管单个[root.GetIndividualName]的毁灭尚不足以引起[Root.GetRulerTitle]的关注，但是该[root.GetIndividualName]肩负着帝国派往多个臣属国的大使的功能。这一行动目的在于动摇星海帝国。
texts.en: Dissidents recently eliminated one of our autonomous liaisons! The termination of a single [root.GetIndividualName] is typically not worth the attention of the [Root.GetRulerTitle], but this [root.GetIndividualName] served an important function as an Imperial ambassador to many of our subject nations. This action has sought to destabilize the Galactic Imperium.

texts.zh: 身份不明的骚乱活动近期切断了我们同一名无人机的连结。这个特殊的单元负责协调[Root.GetRulerTitle]同帝国各成员国之间的活动。一个替代单元正在被写入程序，但是当下这个无人机的损失会削弱我们对整个帝国的掌控。
texts.en: Unidentified insurgents recently terminated one of our drone liaisons. This particular unit was responsible for coordinating activities between the [Root.GetRulerTitle] and the Imperial member states. A replacement is being programmed, but for now the loss of this drone will weaken our control of the Imperium.

texts.zh: 一个[Root.GetRulerTitle]的大型纪念碑最近在[Root.Capital.GetName]被炸上了天！这次胆大妄为的攻击行径直击星海帝国的心脏，是在试图削弱我们的统治。尽管目前还没逮捕嫌疑人，爆炸装置的精妙结构暗实某个政府的特工在背后主导这一切——很可能就是来自帝国成员国中的一个。
texts.en: A large monument to the [Root.GetRulerTitle] was recently blown up on [Root.Capital.GetName]! This brazen attack at the very heart of the Galactic Imperium can only be an attempt to undermine our rule. Although no suspects have been arrested, the sophistication of the explosive device suggests a government agency was behind this - likely from one of the Imperium's member states.

texts.zh: 最近某个外国特工发动了一次炸弹袭击，帝国安全总局的一处办事处被炸毁。这样的恐怖主义行为对帝安局在整个帝国内的公共形象造成了损害——如果他们连自己都不能保护，怎么能指望他们的特工在帝国全境贯彻[Root.GetRulerTitle]的统治呢？
texts.en: A branch office of the Imperial Security Directorate was destroyed in a recent bombing perpetrated by foreign agents. This act of terrorism has done serious harm to the public image of the ISD throughout the Imperium - if they can't even protect themselves, how are their agents supposed to enforce the rule of the [Root.GetRulerTitle]?

texts.zh: 帝国海军的一处募兵中心最近成为了恐怖主义炸弹袭击的目标，尸横遍野。尽管这场袭击对帝国海军的征兵计划几乎没有造成任何影响，但这场炸弹袭击可以视作一个信号，告诫帝国各成员国的帝国公民不要向[Root.GetRulerTitle]宣誓效忠。
texts.en: One of the Imperial Armada's recruitment centers was the recent target of a terrorist bombing that left many dead. Although the actual impact on the Armada's recruitment efforts should be negligible, the bombing seems to have been intended as a message to discourage Imperial citizens in the Imperium's member states from offering their services to the [Root.GetRulerTitle].

texts.zh: 代表意见势力活动的特工最近骇入了[Root.Capital.GetName]上的一处大型亚空间传输器。在我们恢复控制之前，这些谋反分子利用帝国的官方亚空间载波向整个星系传输了一段“叛军宣言”！这一令人尴尬的恐怖主义行径在整个帝国所有成员的众目睽睽之下削弱了我们的权威。
texts.en: Agents acting on behalf of a dissident power recently hacked into a large Subspace Transmitter on [Root.Capital.GetName]. Before our control could be restored, the subversives transmitted a "proclamation of rebellion" across the galaxy using an official Imperial subspace carrier wave! This embarrassing act of terrorism has undermined our authority in the view of the members of the Imperium.
